flora: Mature Laurel trees (medium-sized, dense rounded crowns, glossy foliage)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; dense, lush, and verdant atmosphere; trees forming a soft, green 'wall' of vegetation; reflecting a humid, subtropical climate.

visual_logic.composition: A wide-angle view inside a humid, leafy forest. The laurel trees form a thick mid-canopy. The ground is a carpet of forest-green moss and dark brown leaf litter. Shafts of sunlight filter through the glossy leaves, creating bright highlights.
visual_logic.ground: Damp, dark brown soil mostly obscured by a lush layer of low-growing ferns and moss.
visual_logic.lighting: Warm, humid sunlight filtering through thick leaves, creating a high-contrast environment with bright 'specular' highlights on the waxy foliage.
